ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between mid-to-light gray background pigmentation and numerous low-intensity (black/dark gray) localized circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multi-focal distribution of dark circular mottling across the entire visible surface area of both lobes, with a specific linear concentration of dark spots following a diagonal path on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp, distinct peaks and deep valleys along the continuous horizontal extent of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep trajectory on the trailing edge, curving upward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the right lobe surface, cutting through the primary pigmentation patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of parasitic colonization (barnacle clusters) at both lobe extremities and multiple dark linear scars on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of discrete dark circular spots resembling a speckled or 'polka-dot' pattern concentrated primarily along the mid-to-trailing edge regions.
